items.docs: Get a list of all allowlisted CIDR notations and/or IP addresses for the organization.

Add CIDR notations and/or IP addresses to the allowlist of the organization if not already there. When service allowlisting functionality is enabled, CIDRs/IP addresses that are allowlisted will have access to Sumo Logic and/or content sharing.
Remove allowlisted CIDR notations and/or IP addresses from the organization. Removed CIDRs/IPs will immediately lose access to Sumo Logic and content sharing.

params.name: allowlistType
params.description: The type of allowlisting to be enabled. It can be one of: `Login`, `Content`, or `Both`.

items.docs: Enable service allowlisting functionality for the organization. The service allowlisting can be for 1. Login: If enabled, access to Sumo Logic is granted only to CIDRs/IP addresses that are allowlisted. 2. Content: If enabled, dashboards can be shared with users connecting from CIDRs/IP addresses that are allowlisted without logging in.

params.name: allowlistType
params.description: The type of allowlisting to be disabled. It can be one of: `Login`, `Content`, or `Both`.

items.docs: Disable service allowlisting functionality for login/API authentication or content sharing for the organization.
Get the status of the service allowlisting functionality for login/API authentication or content sharing for the organization.
